metadata.title: Chapter 1 Database 1.0: rights-filtered global island-flora floral and reproductive trait database
metadata.description: Public, rights-filtered derivative of the immutable Chapter 1 Database 1.0 used by the island project. The scientific database contains 222,688 resolved species-by-axis cells across flower colour, floral structural complexity, and reproductive assurance. This public release contains the 46,274 cells that passed the canonical post-PR172 redistribution-rights gate. Scientific trait values are not modified; blocked and review-required cells are omitted rather than reinterpreted. The release records the immutable source-database SHA-256 and the exact rights-audit run, artifact, and digest in PUBLIC_SUBSET_MANIFEST.json. The compilation is distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0, while row-level provenance and upstream source-specific attribution and licence obligations remain preserved.
metadata.notes: This Zenodo dataset is the public redistribution-safe derivative of immutable Database 1.0. Analyses in the associated project remain pinned to the full immutable Database 1.0; the public subset must not be treated as a replacement analytical denominator.
